title: Explicit language before script
description_en: Use the supplied language or document metadata; Greek letters can also occur in formulas and other languages.
requirement: Use the supplied language or document metadata; Greek letters can also occur in formulas and other languages.

title: Greek region and orthography
description_en: Keep el-GR and el-CY distinct from the selected monotonic or polytonic orthography; do not silently replace either axis.
requirement: Keep el-GR and el-CY distinct from the selected monotonic or polytonic orthography; do not silently replace either axis.

title: Protected source spans
description_en: Preserve personal names, marks, code, mathematical notation and quotations; offer edits separately with the exact original span.
requirement: Preserve personal names, marks, code, mathematical notation and quotations; offer edits separately with the exact original span.

title: Derived NFC comparison
description_en: A derived NFC comparison may explain canonical equivalence but never overwrite received UTF-8 bytes.
requirement: A derived NFC comparison may explain canonical equivalence but never overwrite received UTF-8 bytes.

title: Compatibility normalization boundary
description_en: Do not apply NFKC or NFKD across the manuscript; symbol identity and quoted historical forms can carry meaning.
requirement: Do not apply NFKC or NFKD across the manuscript; symbol identity and quoted historical forms can carry meaning.

title: Grapheme boundaries
description_en: Use a target engine supporting extended grapheme clusters for truncation, animation and highlighting; codepoint counts are not visible character counts.
requirement: Use a target engine supporting extended grapheme clusters for truncation, animation and highlighting; codepoint counts are not visible character counts.

title: Tonos and dialytika
description_en: Preserve accents and diaeresis, including combinations in Μαΐου; assess missing or colliding marks in the chosen font rather than removing marks.
requirement: Preserve accents and diaeresis, including combinations in Μαΐου; assess missing or colliding marks in the chosen font rather than removing marks.

title: Contextual uppercase
description_en: For authorized derived uppercase, use full Greek-locale mapping and test isolated ή, accents and diaeresis; generic ASCII mapping is inadequate.
requirement: For authorized derived uppercase, use full Greek-locale mapping and test isolated ή, accents and diaeresis; generic ASCII mapping is inadequate.

title: Titlecase differs from uppercase
description_en: Choose sentence or word-initial capitalization separately from all-caps display text; preserve proper names and branded case.
requirement: Choose sentence or word-initial capitalization separately from all-caps display text; preserve proper names and branded case.

title: Contextual sigma
description_en: Context controls σ and ς in case mapping. A spelling candidate in existing text is advisory and never an automatic final-sigma replacement.
requirement: Context controls σ and ς in case mapping. A spelling candidate in existing text is advisory and never an automatic final-sigma replacement.

title: Greek punctuation equivalence
description_en: Do not require dedicated Greek question-mark or ano-teleia codepoints when canonically equivalent source forms are intentional; preserve the supplied semicolon role.
requirement: Do not require dedicated Greek question-mark or ano-teleia codepoints when canonically equivalent source forms are intentional; preserve the supplied semicolon role.

title: Ano teleia placement
description_en: Check the height and spacing of άνω τελεία with the actual adopted font and weight; codepoint presence does not prove acceptable placement.
requirement: Check the height and spacing of άνω τελεία with the actual adopted font and weight; codepoint presence does not prove acceptable placement.

title: Comma semantics
description_en: Protect ό,τι and decimal commas from generic whitespace cleanup; a punctuation match cannot determine the intended semantic role.
requirement: Protect ό,τι and decimal commas from generic whitespace cleanup; a punctuation match cannot determine the intended semantic role.

title: Quotation policy
description_en: Use a declared house style and quotation nesting; locale defaults are guidance for generated text, not permission to rewrite quotations.
requirement: Use a declared house style and quotation nesting; locale defaults are guidance for generated text, not permission to rewrite quotations.

title: Font instance coverage
description_en: Test adopted font files, weights, NFD marks and mixed-script text; successful loading alone does not prove glyph coverage.
requirement: Test adopted font files, weights, NFD marks and mixed-script text; successful loading alone does not prove glyph coverage.

title: Greek and Latin optical balance
description_en: Compare actual apparent size, baseline and density locally; do not impose a universal scaling factor on every Greek-Latin pair.
requirement: Compare actual apparent size, baseline and density locally; do not impose a universal scaling factor on every Greek-Latin pair.

title: Hyphenation dictionary
description_en: Confirm the Greek locale dictionary and browser or publishing engine before relying on automatic hyphenation; CSS feature support is insufficient.
requirement: Confirm the Greek locale dictionary and browser or publishing engine before relying on automatic hyphenation; CSS feature support is insufficient.

title: Normal word wrapping
description_en: Keep ordinary word-boundary wrapping as the starting point; broad break-all or no-wrap rules require bounded exceptions and real layout review.
requirement: Keep ordinary word-boundary wrapping as the starting point; broad break-all or no-wrap rules require bounded exceptions and real layout review.

title: Accent clipping
description_en: Inspect accent clearance at fixed heights and line boxes in the real output; removing tonos to avoid clipping changes the source.
requirement: Inspect accent clearance at fixed heights and line boxes in the real output; removing tonos to avoid clipping changes the source.

title: Independent accessibility checks
description_en: Run narrow-width, real zoom and user-spacing checks separately, recording the viewport and exceptions instead of treating one screenshot as all three.
requirement: Run narrow-width, real zoom and user-spacing checks separately, recording the viewport and exceptions instead of treating one screenshot as all three.

title: Typed number formatting
description_en: Format typed values through an explicitly selected locale and currency contract; never replace comma and period characters globally in source text.
requirement: Format typed values through an explicitly selected locale and currency contract; never replace comma and period characters globally in source text.

title: Month context
description_en: Test month names in full dates separately from standalone month headings; preserve date-only values and distinguish them from instants.
requirement: Test month names in full dates separately from standalone month headings; preserve date-only values and distinguish them from instants.

title: Plural messages
description_en: Select complete reviewed messages through the installed Greek plural rules; do not construct grammar from a count plus a guessed noun ending.
requirement: Select complete reviewed messages through the installed Greek plural rules; do not construct grammar from a count plus a guessed noun ending.

title: Time and timezone
description_en: Specify time style and timezone independently of language or region; do not change an event instant as a typography adjustment.
requirement: Specify time style and timezone independently of language or region; do not change an event instant as a typography adjustment.

title: Person and tone
description_en: Review address and tone across the same flow and role, keeping intentional quotations and author voice rather than enforcing one national personality.
requirement: Review address and tone across the same flow and role, keeping intentional quotations and author voice rather than enforcing one national personality.

title: Actionable UI wording
description_en: Distinguish label, status, error and recovery action. Shortening text to fit must preserve what failed and what the reader can do.
requirement: Distinguish label, status, error and recovery action. Shortening text to fit must preserve what failed and what the reader can do.

title: Label and language agreement
description_en: Compare visible labels, content language and accessible action names in the target UI; static source inspection alone does not validate an accessibility tree.
requirement: Compare visible labels, content language and accessible action names in the target UI; static source inspection alone does not validate an accessibility tree.

title: Logo and lettering exceptions
description_en: Keep official logos and custom lettering outside ordinary body-copy capitalization and spacing rules; do not redraw an identity to satisfy a checker.
requirement: Keep official logos and custom lettering outside ordinary body-copy capitalization and spacing rules; do not redraw an identity to satisfy a checker.

title: PDF extraction and fallback
description_en: Review PDF pixels and extracted Unicode separately, including fallback, marks and search/copy order in each produced file.
requirement: Review PDF pixels and extracted Unicode separately, including fallback, marks and search/copy order in each produced file.

title: Polytonic and ancient-language scope
description_en: Preserve modern polytonic text and distinguish Ancient Greek scope; the modern el guidance does not certify historical orthography.
requirement: Preserve modern polytonic text and distinguish Ancient Greek scope; the modern el guidance does not certify historical orthography.

title: Cyprus-specific review
description_en: Retain el-CY declarations and record local terminology or institutional practice as requiring regional editorial review when not verified.
requirement: Retain el-CY declarations and record local terminology or institutional practice as requiring regional editorial review when not verified.

title: Design follows purpose
description_en: Select hierarchy, decoration and voice from the task and audience; language detection does not prescribe a palette, ornament or personality.
requirement: Select hierarchy, decoration and voice from the task and audience; language detection does not prescribe a palette, ornament or personality.
